retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 13 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1370749545, files the war under "the post-Soviet conflicts and spillover of the Afghan Civil War (1992–1996)" and neither is a record here; its § Background argues the war out of Gorbachev's perestroika, the Islamic-democratic movement in the Tajik SSR, and demonstrations against the 1991 presidential election, and names the Soviet Union itself only in a category line. The dissolution of the Soviet Union, which this atlas does hold, was read from its own side too, at revision 1375840189: it mentions Tajikistan for the Dushanbe riots of February 1990 and a border clash with Kyrgyzstan in 2021, and argues no line to this war. Writing the obvious edge would be this run's inference and not anybody's page. It waits on a record of the Afghan Civil War of 1992–1996.
